verses.text: The LORD's message came to me:
"Son of man, there were two women, daughters of the same mother.
They became prostitutes in Egypt while they were still young. There men fondled their breasts and caressed their young bodies.
The older one was named Oholah, and her sister was Oholibah. They became mine and gave birth to sons and daughters. Oholah stands for Samaria, and Oholibah stands for Jerusalem.
Oholah was unfaithful to me while she was still mine. She lusted after her lovers, the Assyrians, her neighbors,
dressed in blue, governors and commanders, all of them handsome young men riding on horses.
She gave herself as a prostitute to all the elite men of Assyria. She made herself unclean with the idols of everyone she lusted after.
She never gave up the prostitution she began in Egypt, when men slept with her in her youth, caressed her young body, and poured out their lust on her.
So I handed her over to her lovers, the Assyrians she lusted after.
They stripped her naked, took away her sons and daughters, and killed her with the sword. She became a warning to other women, because she was punished.
Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was even more corrupt in her lust and prostitution than her sister.
She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and commanders, her neighbors, warriors in full dress, riders on horses, all of them handsome young men.
I saw that she too had made herself unclean. Both of them went the same way.
But she went even further in her prostitution. She saw pictures of men carved on a wall, figures of Babylonians painted in red,
with belts around their waists and flowing turbans on their heads. All of them looked like chariot officers, like Babylonians born in Babylonia.
As soon as she saw them, she lusted after them and sent messengers to them in Babylonia.
Then the Babylonians came to her, to her bed of love, and in their lust they made her unclean. After she had been made unclean by them, she turned away from them in disgust.
When she openly carried on her prostitution and exposed her naked body, I turned away from her in disgust, just as I had turned away from her sister.
Yet she became more and more unfaithful as she remembered the days of her youth, when she was a prostitute in Egypt.
She lusted after her lovers there, whose bodies were like those of donkeys and whose lust was like that of stallions.
So you longed for the shameful behavior of your youth, when the Egyptians caressed your young body.
So, Oholibah, this is what the Lord GOD says: I will stir up your lovers against you, the ones you turned away from in disgust. I will bring them against you from every side:

the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, the men of Pekod, Shoa, and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them, handsome young men, all of them governors and commanders, officers and men of high rank, all riding on horses.

They will come against you with weapons, chariots, wagons, and a crowd of peoples. They will take up positions against you on every side with large and small shields and helmets. I will hand you over to them for punishment, and they will punish you by their own standards.

I will turn my jealous anger against you, and they will deal with you in fury. They will cut off your nose and your ears, and those of you who are left will die by the sword. They will take away your sons and daughters, and those who are left will be burned up by fire.
They will strip off your clothes and take your fine jewelry.
So I will put an end to your shameful behavior and the prostitution you began in Egypt. You will no longer look to them with longing or remember Egypt anymore.
For this is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to hand you over to those you hate, to those you turned away from in disgust.

They will treat you with hatred and take away everything you worked for. They will leave you naked and bare, and the shame of your prostitution will be exposed. Your shameful behavior and your prostitution
have brought this on you, because you lusted after the nations and made yourself unclean with their idols.
You have followed the way of your sister, so I will put her cup of punishment into your hand.
This is what the Lord GOD says: You will drink your sister's cup, a cup that is deep and wide. You will be laughed at and mocked, for the cup holds so much.
You will be filled with drunkenness and sorrow. It is a cup of horror and ruin, the cup of your sister Samaria.
You will drink it and drain it dry. Then you will smash it to pieces and tear at your breasts. For I have spoken, says the Lord GOD.
So this is what the Lord GOD says: Because you have forgotten me and turned your back on me, you must bear the consequences of your shameful behavior and your prostitution."
The LORD said to me, "Son of man, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then confront them with their disgusting practices.

They have committed adultery, and their hands are covered with blood. They have committed adultery with their idols. They even sacrificed the children they bore to me, burning them as food for their idols.
They have also done this to me: on that same day they made my holy place unclean and dishonored my Sabbaths.
On the very day they sacrificed their children to their idols, they came into my holy place and dishonored it. That is what they did in my house.
You sisters even sent messengers for men who came from far away. When they arrived, you bathed yourself for them, painted your eyes, and put on your jewelry.
You sat on a fine couch with a table spread in front of it, where you placed my incense and my olive oil.
The noise of a carefree crowd was around her. Drunkards were brought in from the desert along with the common men, and they put bracelets on the women's arms and beautiful crowns on their heads.
Then I said about the one worn out by adultery, 'Now let them use her as a prostitute, for that is all she is.'
And they slept with her as men sleep with a prostitute. That is how they slept with Oholah and Oholibah, those shameful women.
But righteous men will sentence them to the punishment for women who commit adultery and murder, because they are adulteresses, and their hands are covered with blood.
This is what the Lord GOD says: Bring a mob against them, and hand them over to terror and looting.
The mob will stone them and cut them down with their swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn down their houses.
So I will put an end to shameful behavior in the land, so that all women may take warning and not imitate you.
You will be punished for your shameful behavior and suffer the consequences of your sins of idolatry. Then you will know that I am the Lord GOD."
